problems.note: The word 'froglet' is never introduced in the story cards, so a child listening by ear may not know it. Either add a short line to story card 3 (for example, 'Now it is a little frog called a froglet') or use wording the story already supports.

The explanation says a tadpole 'has a tail and no legs.' That is true for young tadpoles, but later tadpoles grow back legs before they change into frogs, as story card 3 describes. Consider 'A tadpole has a tail and looks very different from an adult frog' so the rationale does not conflict with the story.

Card 3 says the tadpole grows legs and gets bigger, but it does not mention that the tail shrinks and is absorbed as the frog develops. This is not false, but it leaves out the main visible change. Adding one short clause would make the change clearer by ear.
